_about: Synthetic personas for offline evaluation. Profiles use the API field names. 'spot_checks' are hand-labelled eligibility expectations (in = scheme should be recommended, eligible or possibly eligible; out = must not be recommended), written by reading each scheme's rules in Backend/db/seed/schemes.data.json. 'relevance' is a hand-written judgement of how useful a scheme is for the persona's story (2 = what an adviser would suggest first, 1 = a useful option); schemes not listed count as 0. All of this is synthetic and was written by the developer, not by real users or scheme officials.

scheme_keys.UYEGP: Tamil Nadu UYEGP - Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme

scheme_keys.ODOP: Uttar Pradesh ODOP Margin Money Scheme

scheme_keys.AABCS: AABCS - Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme
